items.name: 主角·女 · 四方向待机与行走
items.note: 旧 32×48 四方向 20 帧仍在可玩科技区作为功能占位，但已被否定为最终画质基线。高精度像素风南／东／北三张独立静态概念图均有 48 逻辑像素城市试摆；另有一张朝南左腿前迈关键帧完成同等 Godot 1280×720 技术审查。已组装的四相南向可行性循环出现围巾尾与护膝跨帧跳边，动画验收受阻，定点修复进行中；不算正式循环。未接入可玩角色，西向镜像仍在评估，另有 Pixelorama v1.2.3 网页版南向待机单帧技术试点（缩放版与 4 像素发丝高光版各一份 .pxo 与 PNG），未达透明度、色数与身高试点参数；另由确定性脚本从来源图生成 BOX 与 LANCZOS 两张量化候选（80×112、二值透明、48 色、身高 96），数值参数达标但未经人工美术或动画审查。四个变体均有带标签的 48 逻辑像素城市截图；均未接入、未批准，不是行走试点。BOX 与 LANCZOS 候选另在城外通道与旧文明遗址各有 48 逻辑像素截图，报告校验通过，仅证明跨场景可见。来源锁定分层南向行走实验（方法 C）E1–E7、E9 通过，E8 脚步贴地失败，动作不构成自然行走，已停止。用户已否定 BOX 与 LANCZOS 两张静态待机（打磨不足），基线选择为“两者都不用”；先继续精修静态待机帧，行走帧制作（含 Pixelorama 手绘方法 A）暂停，待新的静态待机获用户批准后再开始；尚无手绘行走帧。新静态候选 inkline 与 selout 中，用户选了 selout v1 为更接近者（未批准）；随后在 v1 上逐像素精修出 selout v2（550 像素、27 色、80×112、身高 96），用户认为 v2 更接近，但仍未批准。v2 在科技城、明亮城外、暗色勘察附楼与暗色原型室各有单独的 1280×720 截图，v1 同次对照截图共 8 张；另存 selout v1 的 Pixelorama 可编辑基线 .pxo（内容为 v1，不是 v2）。静态帧继续打磨，行走帧仍暂停。0/1 验收。

items.pixeloramaPilotStatus: Technical south-idle experiments only (one frame, no walk). Downscale and 4-texel paint pass (Pixelorama) miss the alpha, palette and height targets; boxquant and lanczosquant (deterministic script from the source) meet the numeric targets (80x112, 0 partial alpha, 48 colours, 96 height). All four have variant-tagged 48 px city captures. None is art- or animation-approved by a human or runtime-integrated; E10 user review, R2 walk speed and walk frames remain open.
items.segmentedWalkStatus: Method C south walk (LANCZOS idle as provisional input): E1-E7 and E9 pass, E8 foot contact fails (max 3.0 screen px/tick at an isolated 90 logical px/s test speed), not an acceptable natural walk. Stopped; technical evidence only, not integrated or approved. Baseline decision 2026-10-14: the user rejected both Box and Lanczos static idles as insufficiently polished (neither); static idle refinement comes first and walk-frame production, including the hand-drawn Pixelorama method A pilot, is paused until a new static idle is user-approved; no hand-drawn walk frames exist yet.
items.seloutV2Status: The user chose selout v1 as the closer of the two refinement candidates and called the selout v2 static polish closer still, but v2 is NOT approved. Static-frame polish continues; walk frames stay paused. The .pxo is the editable selout v1 baseline, not v2. Not runtime-integrated; 0/52 sprites and 0/11 scenes accepted.
